visualCharacteristics.purpose: Short value points, each with a small icon
visualCharacteristics.description: Compact horizontal items: a small icon/numeral image on the left, an uppercase label and a one-line description on the right; 4 in a row on desktop, 2 on tablet, stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: icon image cell, then a text cell with a bold label paragraph and a description paragraph
contentPattern.rationale: Four look-alike items (icon + label + description) side by side: Cards.

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of short value propositions or features with a small icon beside each. Use cards-teaser when each item has a large image, heading and CTA.
usageDescription: Row of small icon items (4-up desktop, 2-up tablet, stacked mobile). One row per item: icon image cell; text cell with the label as a bold paragraph (rendered uppercase) and a short description paragraph.
